item.title: Calley Means Unloads on Trumpworld, Schumer Faces Revolt, Pilot's Father Speaks Out: AM Update 11/9 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Former MAHA adviser Calley Means goes public over the ways he says some of President Trump's closest advisers are undermining the president's health agenda to protect corporate interests and political donors. Democrats prepare sweeping investigations into the Trump administration as they prepare to take control of Congress, while party leaders face pressure to pursue impeachment proceedings. Senate Democrat Leader Chuck Schumer faces growing opposition from newly-elected senators who are calling for new leadership despite his confidence that he will reclaim the majority leader's position. The father of the 20-year-old co-pilot killed in a deadly Florida Learjet crash defends his daughter's qualifications and praises her courage during the aircraft's final moments.
